summary: Repaired the hard-radio modal-coefficient answer-bank shortcut. All nine checks and all three finalized bands pass. Imported questions and level coverage remain unchanged. The report passed the policy-6 validator.

source_analysis.skill: Expand cosine of a variable plus or minus a familiar radian angle into sine and cosine of that same variable.
reasoning_steps: Choose the cosine sum or difference formula.
Retrieve the special-angle values with correct quadrant signs.
Answer at the displayed expression or coefficient scope.
invariants: Cosine outer function with one symbolic variable and a familiar radian angle.
Preserve complete-expression and coefficient-field response contracts.
Identities hold for every real variable value.
permitted_variations: Sum or difference, variable name, special angle and quadrant.
Coefficient signs and surviving trig term.
Correct-option position and plausible misconception profiles.
